early.name: Muster on the Green
early.hook: Farmhands want to drill with spears once the harvest is in, if someone will show them how.

middle.name: The Spring Levy
middle.hook: Captains from three villages ask to train their levies together before the roads dry.

late.name: The Grand Muster
late.hook: Every banner in the realm wants to march past the capital on the same day. It could be glorious or chaos.

early.name: The Unwatched Ford
early.hook: A ford on the Sellen has no lookout, and smugglers have noticed.

middle.name: The Dark Beacon
middle.hook: A border beacon went unlit for a week. Nobody can say why, or who was supposed to light it.

late.name: A Blind Frontier
late.hook: Scouts report a whole stretch of the border where no tower is manned.

early.name: Runaway Recruits
early.hook: Two young recruits fled the barracks and are hiding at their mother's farm.

middle.name: Empty Bunks
middle.hook: A company came up a dozen soldiers short the morning after payday.

late.name: The Broken Company
late.hook: An entire company has walked off its post, claiming it was promised land and never got it.

early.name: Crates from Restov
early.hook: A Restov trader has surplus spears and shields and wants them gone cheap.

middle.name: Mivoni Steel
middle.hook: A Mivoni smithy offers a contract for good blades, if the terms can be agreed.

late.name: The Dwarven Offer
late.hook: Envoys from a dwarven forge offer to outfit your guard for a price and a favor.

early.name: Toll on the Old Road
early.hook: A handful of thugs are charging travelers a copper apiece to pass a bend in the road.

middle.name: The Stockade Gang
middle.hook: An organized gang has thrown up a stockade and taxes every cart on the trade road.

late.name: The Robber Knight
late.hook: A disgraced knight has fortified a hill and calls the caravans' payments a lawful levy.

early.name: Old Soldiers' Grievance
early.hook: Men who fought for the realm's founding want their part remembered, and they're getting loud about it.

middle.name: The Pension Dispute
middle.hook: Wounded veterans say the treasury forgot the promises made to them.

late.name: March of the Wounded
late.hook: Hundreds of veterans have gathered outside the seat of government and won't leave.

early.name: Cattle Raid
early.hook: Riders from beyond the border drove off a farmer's herd in the night.

middle.name: Skirmish at the Line
middle.hook: A patrol clashed with foreign riders. Both sides say the other started it.

late.name: Probing Attack
late.hook: A neighbor's cavalry is testing your border forts, one at a time.

early.name: Quarterstaff Contest
early.hook: The village fair wants a fighting contest, and someone to keep it from turning into a brawl.

middle.name: Tourney of the Greenbelt
middle.hook: Brevic knights ask to hold a tourney on your fields.

late.name: Tourney of Champions
late.hook: Champions from across the River Kingdoms want to compete in your capital.

early.name: The Hedge Witch's Feud
early.hook: A hedge witch swears she didn't curse her neighbor's goats. The goats say otherwise.

middle.name: Duel of Charms
middle.hook: Two spellcasters' rivalry has soured a town's wells, and each blames the other.

late.name: Arcane Vendetta
late.hook: Two wizards' feud is leaving scorched streets and frightened townsfolk.

early.name: A Crate of Books
early.hook: A dying scholar wants their books to go somewhere they'll be read.

middle.name: The Restov Collection
middle.hook: A Restov archive is selling off a collection, and your scholars want it badly.

late.name: The Buried Library
late.hook: Scholars have found a library buried under an old ruin, if it can be dug out safely.

early.name: Lights over the Marsh
early.hook: Floating lights over the marsh are spooking herders and their animals.

middle.name: Witchfire
middle.hook: The marsh lights are drawing people out into the bog. Two haven't come back.

late.name: The Burning Sky
late.hook: Ribbons of raw magic flicker over the realm at night, and crops wilt where they touch down.

early.name: The Singed Apprentice
early.hook: An apprentice's cantrip set a barn alight. Everyone is fine; the barn is not.

middle.name: Loose in the Market
middle.hook: A summoned creature has got loose in the market and won't go back.

late.name: Rift in the Workshop
late.hook: A failed ritual left a tear in the air of a wizard's tower, and things are coming through.

early.name: The Farmer's Almanac
early.hook: A farmer who watches the stars offers to write a planting almanac for the realm.

middle.name: Observatory Plans
middle.hook: An astrologer wants to build an observatory and needs a patron.

late.name: The Great Conjunction
late.hook: Scholars predict a rare conjunction. A realm that prepares for it could gain a great deal.

early.name: The Unlucky Coin
early.hook: An old coin turned up in a field, and everyone who holds it has a run of bad luck.

middle.name: The Hungry Mirror
middle.hook: A mirror sold at market is wearing its owners thin, one by one.

late.name: Relic of a Fallen Realm
late.hook: A relic from a kingdom long gone has woken, and blight spreads around it.

early.name: A Village Schoolroom
early.hook: Parents want a teacher for their children and a room to teach in.

middle.name: The Academy Charter
middle.hook: A group of scholars asks for a charter to found an academy.

late.name: The University Petition
late.hook: Learned societies from three nations want to found a university in your capital.

early.name: The Bridge Toll
early.hook: A sprite demands a bowl of milk from everyone who crosses a certain bridge.

middle.name: Changeling Rumors
middle.hook: Parents in one village are certain their children have been swapped.

late.name: The Fey Lord's Due
late.hook: A fey noble has arrived to collect an old debt from the land itself.

early.name: Ditch Digging
early.hook: Farmers want a proper ditch dug to water the lower fields.

middle.name: The Mill Race
middle.hook: Millers want a race cut from the river to turn a second wheel.

late.name: The Great Canal
late.hook: Engineers propose a canal that would water a whole valley.

early.name: Rust in the Wheat
early.hook: Orange rust is spreading through one farmer's wheat. The neighbors are worried.

middle.name: Creeping Rot
middle.hook: A rot is moving from field to field faster than anyone can burn it.

late.name: Black Harvest
late.hook: A blight has blackened crops across a whole region.

early.name: The Washed-Out Footbridge
early.hook: Spring floods took the footbridge to the mill, and the long way round is very long.

middle.name: The Cracked Bridge
middle.hook: A stone bridge on the trade road has cracked through. Carts are still using it.

late.name: Collapse on the Sellen
late.hook: A major bridge has fallen into the river, and trade on that road has stopped.

early.name: First Market Day
early.hook: The village wants to hold its first proper market day.

middle.name: The Harvest Fair
middle.hook: Farmers want a harvest fair to sell their surplus and show off their best animals.

late.name: The Great Fair
late.hook: Merchants from across the region ask to hold a great fair in your lands.

early.name: The Foul Well
early.hook: The village well smells wrong, and two families have fallen sick.

middle.name: Sickly Cisterns
middle.hook: The town's cisterns are breeding sickness, and nobody remembers who built them.

late.name: The Tainted Aqueduct
late.hook: Something is fouling the aqueduct that feeds a whole city.

early.name: A Wagon of Settlers
early.hook: A family from Brevoy has arrived with a wagon and wants land to work.

middle.name: The Settler Caravan
middle.hook: A caravan of settlers asks where they may build.

late.name: The Great Migration
late.hook: Thousands fleeing war in a neighboring land are at your border, asking to stay.

early.name: Wolves at the Fold
early.hook: Wolves are taking sheep from the high pastures.

middle.name: Stalker in the Fields
middle.hook: Something large is killing livestock and leaving no tracks.

late.name: Wyvern over the Pastures
late.hook: A wyvern has made its nest above the best grazing in the realm.

early.name: Leaking Roofs
early.hook: Half the village roofs leak, and the thatcher is booked through spring.

middle.name: Tenement Fire
middle.hook: A fire tore through crowded housing. People need roofs before the cold comes.

late.name: The Sinking Quarter
late.hook: A whole district of the city is slowly sinking into soft ground.

early.name: The Long Line
early.hook: The line of petitioners at the door stretches round the building. Folks are getting tired of waiting.

middle.name: Grievance Day
middle.hook: Every village has sent someone with a complaint, and they all want to be heard the same afternoon.

late.name: The Petition of a Thousand
late.hook: A petition with a thousand marks demands the crown hear it in public.

early.name: Tavern Talk
early.hook: Someone's spreading a story in the taverns that the leaders are skimming the grain stores.

middle.name: The Pamphleteer
middle.hook: Unsigned pamphlets accuse the council of crimes. They're well written, which is worse.

late.name: A Rival Claimant
late.hook: A noble with a thin claim to the land is quietly gathering supporters.

early.name: Choosing a Reeve
early.hook: A village wants to pick its own reeve and asks the crown to bless the choice.

middle.name: The Town Charter
middle.hook: A growing town asks for a charter and a council of its own.

late.name: The Great Assembly
late.hook: Delegates from every settlement ask to meet as one assembly before the throne.

early.name: The Greedy Reeve
early.hook: A village reeve is taking a cut of every fine, and the villagers know it.

middle.name: A Judge for Hire
middle.hook: Word is a magistrate can be bought, and the price isn't even high.

late.name: Rot in the Ministry
late.hook: An entire office of the government is selling favors to the highest bidder.

early.name: A Visit to the Mill
early.hook: The miller's family would be honored if a leader came to see the new wheel.

middle.name: The Royal Progress
middle.hook: The crown is invited to tour the provinces and be seen by its people.

late.name: The Grand Progress
late.hook: A season-long progress through every corner of the realm could bind it together.

early.name: Ears in the Tavern
early.hook: A barkeep offers to pass on what she hears, for a small fee.

middle.name: A Network of Eyes
middle.hook: A former spy offers to build the crown a network of informants.

late.name: The Silent Office
late.hook: Your spymaster proposes a proper intelligence service, if the crown can stomach it.

early.name: Who's Next?
early.hook: Folks keep asking who would rule if something happened to the leaders. Nobody has a good answer.

middle.name: The Heir Question
middle.hook: Noble houses are lining up behind different heirs before anyone's even named one.

late.name: Factions at Court
late.hook: The court has split into factions over the succession, and both are recruiting.

early.name: Poachers' Pardon
early.hook: Some poachers say they'd go straight if the crown forgave the last winter's deer.

middle.name: Bandits Come In
middle.hook: A bandit crew offers to lay down its arms in exchange for a pardon and land.

late.name: The Great Amnesty
late.hook: A general pardon could empty the hills of outlaws, or fill the towns with them.

early.name: The Traveling Players
early.hook: A troupe of players wants somewhere to perform and a meal after.

middle.name: A Season of Plays
middle.hook: A Mivoni company offers a whole season of plays if a stage can be found.

late.name: The Royal Theater
late.hook: A famous playwright wants to premiere a work about your realm's founding.

early.name: Two Faiths, One Shrine
early.hook: Two congregations both claim the village shrine and keep moving each other's candles.

middle.name: The Heretic Preacher
middle.hook: A street preacher is drawing crowds with sermons the temples call heresy.

late.name: Schism
late.hook: A great temple has split down the middle, and the faithful are taking sides in the streets.

early.name: Harvest Supper
early.hook: The village wants a harvest supper and a bonfire, and someone to bless the bread.

middle.name: The Lantern Festival
middle.hook: Townsfolk want to float lanterns on the river for the dead, as their grandparents did.

late.name: The Feast of the Realm
late.hook: A realm-wide festival could have every settlement celebrating on the same night.

early.name: A Two-Headed Calf
early.hook: A calf was born with two heads, and the whole village thinks it means something.

middle.name: The Weeping Statue
middle.hook: A statue in the square has started weeping, and pilgrims are sleeping in the street.

late.name: The Red Comet
late.hook: A red comet hangs in the sky, and every prophet in the realm has an opinion.

early.name: The Old Woman's Tales
early.hook: An old woman knows every story about the land, and nobody has written them down.

middle.name: The Founding Ballad
middle.hook: A bard wants to write the ballad of the realm's founding, if someone will tell it right.

late.name: The Chronicle
late.hook: Scholars and poets propose a proper chronicle of the realm, to be read for centuries.

early.name: Paint on the Well
early.hook: Someone painted rude pictures of the leaders on the village well.

middle.name: The Broken Monument
middle.hook: The founders' monument was smashed in the night.

late.name: The Burned Gallery
late.hook: A gallery of the realm's finest art went up in flames, and it wasn't an accident.

early.name: A Village Wedding
early.hook: Two families want a leader to stand witness at their wedding.

middle.name: A Noble Match
middle.hook: Two noble houses are marrying and want the crown's blessing in public.

late.name: A Royal Wedding
late.hook: A marriage between your court and a foreign house would be the event of the decade.

early.name: No Room in the Graveyard
early.hook: The village graveyard is full, and folks don't like the new plot by the river.

middle.name: Restless Dead
middle.hook: Families say their dead won't rest because the rites were done wrong.

late.name: The Plague Pits
late.hook: Old plague pits have been dug up for a new road, and the whole city is frightened.

early.name: A Letter from Restov
early.hook: A minor Restov noble writes asking about trade and a visit.

middle.name: The Mivoni Envoy
middle.hook: An envoy from Mivon has arrived with gifts and questions.

late.name: The Grand Embassy
late.hook: A great embassy from a powerful neighbor wants a treaty, and it's watching how it's treated.

early.name: Trouble on the Sellen
early.hook: Someone's been cutting barges loose at night on the Sellen.

middle.name: River Raiders
middle.hook: Raiders in fast boats are hitting river traffic and vanishing downstream.

late.name: The Pirate Fleet
late.hook: A pirate captain has a fleet on the river and is calling it a kingdom.

early.name: Whose Field Is It?
early.hook: A farmer on the border swears his field belongs to you. His neighbor swears it doesn't.

middle.name: The Moved Stones
middle.hook: Someone moved the border stones in the night, and a neighbor's soldiers have noticed.

late.name: A Claim on Your Land
late.hook: A neighboring ruler has published a claim to one of your provinces.

early.name: The Ferryman's Offer
early.hook: A ferryman wants to run a regular crossing if the crown backs him.

middle.name: A River Packet
middle.hook: A boatwright proposes a packet boat running between your river towns.

late.name: The River Fleet
late.hook: Shipwrights propose a fleet of barges to carry the realm's trade downriver.

early.name: The Offended Merchant
early.hook: A visiting merchant says he was insulted at the inn and is threatening to tell everyone.

middle.name: A Diplomatic Slight
middle.hook: A foreign guest was seated badly at a feast, and their country has taken notice.

late.name: The Envoy's Fury
late.hook: An ambassador was humiliated in public, and war talk has started.

early.name: A Boat Gone Missing
early.hook: A fishing boat didn't come home from the lake last night.

middle.name: Wreck on the Rapids
middle.hook: A cargo barge broke up on the rapids, and the crew are stranded.

late.name: The Sunken Convoy
late.hook: A whole convoy sank in a storm, with goods three nations were waiting on.

early.name: Captives to Trade
early.hook: Kobolds have a captured trapper and want one of theirs back.

middle.name: Prisoners of War
middle.hook: A neighbor offers to trade prisoners from the last skirmish.

late.name: The Exchange of Wards
late.hook: A powerful house offers to swap fostered children with your court as a pledge of peace.

early.name: Boat Races
early.hook: Fisherfolk want to hold boat races on the lake.

middle.name: The Regatta
middle.hook: River towns from three nations want to race on your stretch of water.

late.name: The River Kings' Gathering
late.hook: Rulers along the river propose a gathering on your shore. Everyone will be watching.

early.name: Funny Money
early.hook: Merchants are finding light coins in their tills.

middle.name: The Counterfeit Ring
middle.hook: Somebody's minting fake coin, and it's good enough to fool the moneychangers.

late.name: A Flood of False Coin
late.hook: False coin is everywhere, and folks have stopped trusting the realm's money.

early.name: A Smith Settles
early.hook: A blacksmith wants to set up a forge if the crown helps with the first year's iron.

middle.name: The Weavers' Hall
middle.hook: Weavers want to build a hall and work together.

late.name: The Great Works
late.hook: Investors propose great workshops that could make the realm rich, or make a mess.

early.name: The Salt Seller
early.hook: The only salt seller in the village has tripled his prices.

middle.name: The Grain Hoarders
middle.hook: Merchants are hoarding grain to drive up the price before winter.

late.name: The Cartel
late.hook: The big merchant houses have fixed prices across the realm, and folks are going hungry.

early.name: The Carpenters Ask
early.hook: The village carpenters want to form a guild and set fair wages.

middle.name: A Guild Charter
middle.hook: Craft guilds ask for royal charters and the rights that come with them.

late.name: The Guild Council
late.hook: Every guild in the realm wants a seat on a council of trade.

early.name: Missing Tithes
early.hook: A whole village swears its tithes got lost on the road.

middle.name: The Hidden Ledgers
middle.hook: A merchant house has been keeping two sets of books.

late.name: The Tax Revolt
late.hook: A province refuses to pay, and they've got good reasons and bad tempers.

early.name: A Cave-In
early.hook: A small dig collapsed, and two miners are trapped.

middle.name: Flooded Shafts
middle.hook: The mine's lower shafts have flooded, and work has stopped.

late.name: The Deep Collapse
late.hook: A whole mine has caved in, and the workers who got out won't go back.

early.name: A Peddler's Cart
early.hook: A peddler wants to sell here every month if the road is safe.

middle.name: The Caravan Master
middle.hook: A caravan master offers to make your capital a regular stop.

late.name: The Trade Road
late.hook: Great merchant houses propose a trade road through your realm.

early.name: The Moneylender
early.hook: A moneylender is calling in debts all at once, and families are losing their homes.

middle.name: Old Loans
middle.hook: A Brevic bank claims the realm owes it for loans taken before the founding.

late.name: The Creditors' Ships
late.hook: Foreign creditors have seized your merchants' goods downriver.

early.name: Blaze the Trail
early.hook: Trappers want the forest trails marked so folks stop getting lost.

middle.name: The Survey
middle.hook: A surveyor offers to map the land between your settlements properly.

late.name: The Great Survey
late.hook: Cartographers propose mapping the whole realm, every hill and ford.

early.name: Lost in the Woods
early.hook: Two hunters went into the Narlmarches three days ago and haven't come out.

middle.name: The Missing Patrol
middle.hook: A ranger patrol missed its check-in and its trail goes cold at a river.

late.name: Swallowed by the Wild
late.hook: A whole village's hunting party vanished, and something is leaving signs at the treeline.

early.name: Snares in the Royal Wood
early.hook: Someone's setting snares in the woods the crown keeps for itself.

middle.name: The Poaching Gang
middle.hook: A gang is taking deer by the cartload and selling the meat across the border.

late.name: The Great Hunt
late.hook: Foreign nobles are holding hunts on your land without asking.

early.name: Mushroom Season
early.hook: The mushrooms are in, and the foragers say it's the best year in memory.

middle.name: Honey and Wax
middle.hook: Wild hives in the hills could supply the whole realm with honey and wax.

late.name: The Golden Wood
late.hook: A rare tree has come into bloom across the forest, and its fruit is worth a fortune.

early.name: Strange Tracks
early.hook: Herders found tracks by the pond that nobody can name.

middle.name: Something in the Hills
middle.hook: Livestock keep going missing near the hills, and the tracks are getting bigger.

late.name: The Beast's Trail
late.hook: A trail of broken trees runs across three provinces, and it's heading for a town.

early.name: Stones in the Grass
early.hook: A shepherd found carved stones in a meadow.

middle.name: The Hidden Ruin
middle.hook: Explorers found a ruin nobody knew about, half buried in the hills.

late.name: The Lost City
late.hook: An expedition swears it found the edge of a lost city past the frontier.

early.name: Smoke on the Ridge
early.hook: There's smoke on the ridge, and the wind is turning toward the village.

middle.name: The Wildfire
middle.hook: A wildfire is burning through the woods and the farms beyond them.

late.name: The Burning Forest
late.hook: A great forest is on fire, and the smoke can be seen from the capital.

early.name: A Look Over the Hill
early.hook: Young folks want to scout the land past the border.

middle.name: The Frontier Rangers
middle.hook: Veteran rangers offer to patrol the frontier if the crown pays them.

late.name: The Wardens' Order
late.hook: Rangers propose a proper order of wardens to watch the whole realm's edges.

early.name: A Plot for the Smith
early.hook: The village smith asks for a strip of crown land to build a bigger shop.

middle.name: Grants for Loyal Service
middle.hook: Captains and clerks who served well ask for land grants as reward.

late.name: The New Baronies
late.hook: Loyal houses ask to be raised to baronies with lands of their own.

early.name: The Pig Ordinance
early.hook: A new rule about keeping pigs in town has folks furious.

middle.name: The Curfew Riots
middle.hook: A curfew meant to stop thieves has started fights in the streets instead.

late.name: The Hated Edict
late.hook: A royal edict has whole provinces refusing to obey.

early.name: The Missing Stamp
early.hook: The reeve's seal has gone missing, and forged permits are turning up.

middle.name: Forged Writs
middle.hook: Writs with the council's seal are ordering things the council never ordered.

late.name: The Stolen Signet
late.hook: The crown's own signet is gone, and someone is using it.

early.name: Swearing In
early.hook: New settlers want to swear loyalty to the realm properly, with a leader present.

middle.name: The Oath of Fealty
middle.hook: Local lords offer to swear fealty in public if the crown will host it.

late.name: The Great Oath
late.hook: Every lord and mayor in the realm could renew their oaths in one great ceremony.

early.name: Children on the Road
early.hook: Three children turned up at the village alone, and nobody knows whose they are.

middle.name: The Orphan Problem
middle.hook: Orphans are sleeping in the town's alleys, and the temples are full.

late.name: A City of Orphans
late.hook: War and sickness have left hundreds of children with no one.

early.name: A Carver's Gift
early.hook: A woodcarver offers to carve a sign for the village hall.

middle.name: The Fountain Commission
middle.hook: A sculptor wants to build a fountain in the town square.

late.name: The Colossus
late.hook: A master sculptor proposes a great statue of the founders that could be seen for miles.

early.name: A Saint's Day Feast
early.hook: The village shrine wants to honor its saint with a feast.

middle.name: The Pilgrim Road
middle.hook: Pilgrims want a road and inns to reach a holy site in your land.

late.name: The Holy Relic
late.hook: A great temple offers to lend a sacred relic for a year, if it's treated right.

early.name: A Rude Song
early.hook: There's a song going round about the leaders, and it's catchy and very rude.

middle.name: The Satirist
middle.hook: A satirist's plays make the court look foolish, and the crowds love it.

late.name: The Song of Rebellion
late.hook: A song is spreading across the realm that sounds a lot like a call to revolt.

early.name: The Bad Drill
early.hook: A militia drill went wrong, and a farmhand took a spear through the leg.

middle.name: The Barracks Brawl
middle.hook: Two companies brawled in the barracks over an insult, and the officers joined in.

late.name: The Friendly Fire
late.hook: Troops on maneuvers burned a village they mistook for an enemy camp.

early.name: The Old Palisade
early.hook: An old palisade near the village could be patched up and used again.

middle.name: The Abandoned Keep
middle.hook: A keep from before the founding stands empty on a good hill.

late.name: The Fortress Line
late.hook: Engineers propose a chain of forts along the frontier.

early.name: Sellswords at the Inn
early.hook: A few sellswords at the inn are looking for work guarding the roads.

middle.name: The Free Company
middle.hook: A mercenary company offers its swords for the season.

late.name: The Mercenary Army
late.hook: A famous mercenary general offers an army for hire, at a steep price.

early.name: Panic at the Gate
early.hook: A rumor that raiders are coming has the village barricading itself.

middle.name: Siege Fever
middle.hook: A town is hoarding food and turning away travelers, sure it's about to be attacked.

late.name: The Phantom Army
late.hook: Half the realm believes an army is coming, and folks are fleeing toward the capital.

early.name: The Rude Visitor
early.hook: A neighbor's steward came to complain about your hunters and won't stop shouting.

middle.name: The Ultimatum
middle.hook: A neighbor's envoy delivers an ultimatum about trade on the river.

late.name: The Declaration
late.hook: A foreign power has sent heralds to read out its grievances in your capital's square.

early.name: Fish for Salt
early.hook: Fisherfolk on the lake want to trade their catch for salt from downriver.

middle.name: The Lake Fleet
middle.hook: Boatwrights offer to build trading boats for the lakes.

late.name: The Inland Sea Trade
late.hook: Merchants propose shipping your goods all the way to distant ports.

early.name: The Night Boat
early.hook: A boat slips past the village every night with no lights.

middle.name: The Smugglers' Cove
middle.hook: Smugglers have a cove on the river and are running goods past your tolls.

late.name: The Black Fleet
late.hook: A smuggling ring runs a whole fleet through your waters, and some of your officials are paid off.

early.name: A Visiting Scholar
early.hook: A scholar from a neighboring land wants to stay a season and learn your customs.

middle.name: The Exchange of Students
middle.hook: A neighbor offers to trade students between your schools.

late.name: The Embassy House
late.hook: Several nations want to open permanent embassies in your capital.

early.name: A Dangerous Book
early.hook: A peddler sold a book that gives folks nightmares.

middle.name: The Banned Treatise
middle.hook: A treatise on forbidden magic is being copied and passed around in secret.

late.name: The Black Grimoire
late.hook: A grimoire of terrible power has surfaced, and several factions want it.

early.name: A Charmed Plow
early.hook: A hedge mage offers to charm a plow so it never dulls.

middle.name: The Spellwrights
middle.hook: Spellwrights offer to enchant tools for the realm's workshops.

late.name: The Arcane Foundry
late.hook: Wizards propose a foundry that makes enchanted goods for trade.

early.name: A Hailstorm Curse
early.hook: A farmer swears a witch sent the hail that flattened his barley.

middle.name: The Rainmaker
middle.hook: A rainmaker's spell went wrong, and it hasn't stopped raining for two weeks.

late.name: The Storm That Won't Leave
late.hook: A magical storm has parked over a province and won't move.

early.name: A Traveling Lecturer
early.hook: A lecturer wants to talk about the stars in the village hall.

middle.name: The Debating Society
middle.hook: Scholars want to hold public debates on philosophy and magic.

late.name: The Great Symposium
late.hook: Sages from across the Inner Sea want to gather in your capital.

early.name: The Nervous Lender
early.hook: Folks are pulling their savings from the village moneylender all at once.

middle.name: The Counting House Panic
middle.hook: A rumor has everyone pulling their coin from the counting houses.

late.name: The Crash
late.hook: A great merchant bank has failed, and the realm's trade is seizing up.

early.name: Good Stone
early.hook: A farmer found good building stone in his back field.

middle.name: The Marble Seam
middle.hook: Prospectors found a seam of marble that builders would pay well for.

late.name: The Great Quarry
late.hook: Engineers propose opening a great quarry that could supply three nations.

early.name: The Mill Walkout
early.hook: The mill hands walked off the job over wages.

middle.name: The Guild Strike
middle.hook: A guild has stopped work across the town until its demands are met.

late.name: The General Strike
late.hook: Workers across the realm have put down their tools.

early.name: Fine Furs
early.hook: Trappers have fine furs and want a buyer who pays fair.

middle.name: The Spice Merchant
middle.hook: A spice merchant wants to open a shop and bring in rare goods.

late.name: The Silk Road
late.hook: Merchants from far away want your realm as a stop on their luxury route.

early.name: A Windmill on the Hill
early.hook: Farmers want a windmill so they stop hauling grain to the river mill.

middle.name: The Granary
middle.hook: The town wants a proper granary to keep grain through bad years.

late.name: The Great Granaries
late.hook: Engineers propose granaries in every province to end hunger for good.

early.name: The Creek Rises
early.hook: The creek's over its banks, and the low fields are under water.

middle.name: The River Floods
middle.hook: The river has flooded a town, and families are on their roofs.

late.name: The Great Flood
late.hook: Floods have swallowed whole valleys, and the waters aren't going down.

early.name: Apple Saplings
early.hook: A traveler offers apple saplings from a famous orchard.

middle.name: The Vineyard
middle.hook: A winemaker thinks your hills could grow good grapes.

late.name: The Royal Orchards
late.hook: Gardeners propose great orchards whose fruit would be known across the Inner Sea.

early.name: Grasshoppers
early.hook: Grasshoppers are eating a farmer's oats down to the dirt.

middle.name: The Swarm
middle.hook: A swarm of locusts is moving through the farmland.

late.name: The Plague of Locusts
late.hook: Locusts have darkened the sky over three provinces.

early.name: The Hermit
early.hook: A hermit in the woods knows every path and might share them, for company.

middle.name: The Druid's Circle
middle.hook: Druids offer to tend the forest if the crown leaves their grove alone.

late.name: The Green Council
late.hook: Druids, rangers and fey propose a pact to watch over the wild lands together.

early.name: Something Under the Bridge
early.hook: Travelers say something under the old bridge asks them riddles.

middle.name: The Troll Toll
middle.hook: A troll has moved under a busy bridge and eats anyone who won't pay.

late.name: The Troll Clan
late.hook: A clan of trolls has taken a mountain pass and closed it.

early.name: A Cave Behind the Falls
early.hook: Kids found a cave behind the waterfall, and it goes a long way back.

middle.name: The Cave Network
middle.hook: Explorers found caves that run under half the province.

late.name: The Underdark Gate
late.hook: Delvers found a passage that leads very deep. Something down there noticed.

early.name: The Angry Boar
early.hook: A boar has torn up three gardens and charged a child.

middle.name: The Bear in the Orchard
middle.hook: A huge bear has claimed the town orchard and won't leave.

late.name: The Owlbear Plague
late.hook: Owlbears are coming out of the forest in numbers nobody has seen before.
